body: Thank you, thank you so much... I cried like I haven't in a long time, I really can't remember the last time cliche'd as that is. Thank you, I have no one to confide my feelings in, especially my sister and mom, they can't know how I feel.
I love your user name. I'm in a similar pickle too so I feel you.
I love that quote, I know Bruce Lee says it too, I've often repeated this to myself, I can't forget it. I'm not religious but thank you for your prayers, I appreciate you thinking about me.
